# statusdrift_status_page_section (Data Source)

Fetches a single status page section by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `status_page_id` (Number) The ID of the parent status page.

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the section.
- `name` (String) The name of the section.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the section.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the section is enabled.
- `expanded` (Boolean) Whether the section is expanded by default.
- `position` (Number) The display position of the section.
